quotes.text: Dynamics 365, asset management keeps that working record together for physical equipment, and the maintenance jobs tied to it.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Defines in one sentence what the product actually does.

quotes.text: Plan maintenance isn't about repairing equipment that works perfectly. It's about doing small, known jobs at sensible times, so a small issue doesn't grow into an unexpected failure during the busiest shift of the week.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clear argument for planned maintenance over reactive repairs.

quotes.text: You don't replace a part just because a date appears on a calendar. You replace it when the plan, the equipment use and the readings show the work is due.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concise rule for combining schedules with usage and sensor readings.

quotes.text: The sensor provides the signal, but the technician still decides what that signal means, and whether the equipment needs inspection, repair, or a closer look.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Keeps human judgment at the centre of sensor-driven maintenance.

chapters.title: Why physical assets become a business problem
The asset record and functional locations
Connected to supply chain, finance and field service

takeaways: Dynamics 365 Asset Management gives every machine a record with identity, functional location, structure and full service history.
Maintenance plans can be driven by calendar schedules, running hours and sensor readings, so work happens when it is actually due.
Work orders connect each repair to parts, purchasing and costs, so spending follows the machine to the right location.
hook: When a conveyor stops or a forklift won't start, teams often scramble through spreadsheets and phone calls to find service history and parts. This episode explains Dynamics 365 Asset Management in plain English for operations, maintenance and finance teams. You learn how asset records, maintenance plans and work orders turn emergency repairs into planned work.
